scope.question: Current source coverage for competing Mental Binding control, shared guard-order precedence, command phases, and relation termination/resumption.

sourceMatrix.acquisition: Selection of a Wizard Hero card; W17N selected it at Wizard level 16 (conditional profile acquisitionLedger pointer /acquisitionLedger/15/choices/0). It is also in W17N alwaysPrepared; it is not listed as a separate ordinary spellbook preparation.
sourceMatrix.target: One creature within 60 feet; no type exclusion in the card.
sourceMatrix.saveAndEffect: Target makes WIS save; failure becomes Charmed, with repeat saves at each turn end and on damage.
sourceMatrix.firstAffectedTurn: Choose Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel, or Strike. Up to half Speed, one object interaction, or one ordinary weapon attack; target spends its normal Action only if an attack is made. At most one normal Action per turn is replaced; shared hard-denial mark applies. Later turns retain normal Actions, but Charmed target cannot willingly attack caster. No self-harm, resource expenditure, belief rewrite, or permanent allegiance.

sourceMatrix.acquisition: Selection; W17N acquired at level 14 (conditional profile acquisitionLedger pointer /acquisitionLedger/13/choices/0).
sourceMatrix.effect: Adds +2 Wizard save DC for Enchantment spells; level-1 school bonus stacks only if Enchantment is the Arcane School. W17N school is Necromancy. Return333’s R01 record uses Enchantment DC 21 and explicitly excludes a Necromancy school bonus.

sourceMatrix.finding: The native Ferry source is Undead and has no printed Charmed condition immunity. Mental Binding’s generic creature target therefore admits Ferry in this conditional source setup; no save roll or outcome is invented.

sourceMatrix.topic: Decay command guard and precedence procedure
sourceMatrix.guardRule: NEW nonconsensual replacement of an actual Action/movement is hard control and uses the existing source-character(the ultimate caster)/target/encounter guard across all that character's sources, never a new guard per avatar. Prevented/illegal/unexecuted command spends no guard; execution spends it once. Later commands from that caster cannot force that target again and receive no invented soft fallback. Freely cooperating targets may voluntarily comply using their own legal agency; that is not permission to declare an unwilling target cooperative. Existing hard-control immunity is respected. Competing force orders preserve both histories and resolve earlier valid reservation first; later cannot replace a completed slot. No universal newest-control rule. PC retains actual target/route choice and source restrictions; no compelled expenditure, self-harm, item transfer or secret disclosure. Requested ordinary attack, Dodge or safe movement must be lawful. Structural source-owner caps can make a particular target unavailable without suppressing unrelated owners.
sourceMatrix.ownerCommandRule: KEEP one owner-wide command and one offensive-companion allowance per numbered round, including other families, except the exact Army/Decay cohorts explicitly selected below. NEW audible Common command, owner perception and LoE, same plane and within60ft to the commanded body at issuance and execution. Issue with a genuine Bonus Action during the controller's actual regular turn; an unspent wallet outside that turn is insufficient. The owner's whole turn ends before the original-source-owner attached phase. A new body may execute in that upcoming phase of its creation round if legally commanded; no free creation attack. One declared movement budget can precede/between permitted strike components; no hidden retarget. An impossible, suppressed, out-of-range, dead, budget-starved or expired order fails without refund and is cleared at its designated phase. Never bank/replay. Replacement overwrites an unexecuted order only through a newly legal paid command; it cannot restore an already spent shared allowance. Uncommanded capable generated bodies only reposition defensively within Speed and Dodge at their existing attached phase. They have no independent initiative, generic Reaction, spell list, resource pool, tactical stance or autonomous offense.
sourceMatrix.relayEndingRule: NEW each single-order control relation ends immediately after its one designated execution, restoring original controller without healing or a fresh opportunity. An unexecuted order expires at its exact single designated opportunity, on actual source loss, control/body suppression, loss of type/reach/communication/LoE/plane or invalidity; clear reservations immediately, retaining costs/spent guards. Parent expiry/dismissal/ordinary zero ends every created relation; NullDisabled0 makes avatar incapable and cancels orders while retaining its body. Rider-only suppression cancels only the affected relay. Agency restores prospectively with original owner, effects, HP, resources, schedule and already-spent history. Never resurrect, resummon, grant a fresh Action or replay old order. A new avatar/caster must pass actual shared guards and identity-specific source rules; prior ownership/claims are not deleted.
sourceMatrix.finding: A forced Action/movement uses the shared source-character/target/encounter hard-control guard across that caster’s sources. Prevented, illegal, or unexecuted orders spend no guard; execution spends once. Competing force orders preserve both histories and the earlier valid reservation wins; a later order cannot replace a completed slot. No universal newest-control rule.
